content: <thought>After searching the template catalog with the essential bond changes (formation of C‑C and C‑O bonds, breaking of a C‑O bond) for the flavanone product, several candidate templates were returned. The template with reaction_id 614 (template_hash fd3dc544f879368db2b0fbb9d522745ae8c84d2a8ffa38f20bb289a8dc8a2b65) has a mapped reaction SMILES that corresponds to the intramolecular Michael addition/cyclization of chalcones to flavanones (formation of a new C‑C bond and a C‑O ether bond, breaking of a phenolic C‑O bond). This template is the appropriate retrosynthetic transformation. The required output is the mapped reaction SMILES and the template_id (reaction_id).
